# Spec: Compare two texts with embeddings

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/compare-two-texts.md)

**Start:** `/ai/embeddings`  
**Persona:** A developer learning how semantic similarity works  
**Goal:** Turn two sentences into vectors and read how close they are.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Enter two texts | Both text boxes hold the entered sentences. |
| 2 | Embed and compare | Dimensions shows 384.<br>A cosine similarity is displayed. |
